description: Takes over from Dependabot with the same behaviour: one grouped pull request per manager per week, and every update merges itself once all checks are green, majors included. A pull request labelled no-automerge is held. There is no dashboard issue. Pull requests open on Mondays, all day and all in the same run, and merge at any hour, because Mend runs a repository only once a day until its first Renovate pull request is merged. This repository is a fork, and Renovate skips forks unless forkProcessing is enabled. See https://github.com/sapn95/.github/blob/main/CI.md.

packageRules.description: The workflows' actions, in one pull request.

Only the actions themselves, as Dependabot did. The golangci-lint version and the Postgres service the tests run against stay as written; Postgres matches the compose files, and both are changed by hand.
go.mod, in one pull request. go mod tidy keeps go.sum complete.
The Dockerfile's build and runtime images, in one pull request.
